In article <90lita$85l$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

afterh...@my-deja.com wrote:
> This is something we had on our last tournament...
>
> Luk, Peter and Ken are sitting at a table in that order
>
> luk has 4 BP, peter 6 BP and Ken 3 BP left
>
> Luk plays Consanguinious Condemnation doing 6 damage to peter and 5 to
> Ken and 5 to himself...

It would be impossible to do this - CC only taps all vampires of a
clan. Even if all the players had vampires of the same clan, they would
not lose pool as a result of this card.

You may mean Anarchist Uprising, Ancilla Empowerment, or even Domain
Challenge.

> what happens with VP and Blood you would gain by ousting someone ?

All would be ousted simultaneously, so I guess it would count as a draw
unless anyone else was left.

I'm probably wrong, though.

DH



Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>All would be ousted simultaneously, so I guess it would count as a draw
>unless anyone else was left.

The predator of each person ousted would get a VP point, but if the predator is
also ousted he/she does NOT get the 6 pool (+/- if Political Flux was played).

So in that three-player setup with three simultaneous oustings, each person
gets 1 VP but no one gets the 6 pool. I think.

Halcyan 2
